_comment: Cached Figma variable/node IDs for the wend-ui file, so use_figma pushes and diffs can reference known IDs instead of re-discovering them via a fresh read every time. IDs are stable in Figma once created -- this only goes stale if a variable/node is renamed or deleted outside this workflow. Regenerate with figma-scripts/dump-variable-map.js (paste its contents into a use_figma call) whenever collections change, and spot-check a few IDs with getVariableByIdAsync before trusting a map that's more than a few sessions old.

global._naming_note: Naming is inconsistent by when each variable was added, not by any semantic rule: the original gray-25..600 and most spacing/radius/font-* steps use slash-style (color/gray/25, spacing/100), while gray-700..1000 and every amber/green/red step added later use dash-style (color-gray-700, color-amber-500). Code's own token names are always dash-style (color-gray-*), so a diff_tokens comparison against this collection's slash-named entries will report those as onlyInProject/onlyInFigma purely from the naming mismatch even when the resolved hex is identical -- normalize slashes to dashes before diffing (see sync-tokens-to-figma skill). color-green-500/color-red-500 (the dark-mode feedback shades) now live in this collection's variableIds normally -- the prior '_orphaned, detached from variableIds' state noted here as of 2026-08-03 no longer applies as of this refresh.

semantic._naming_note: Mixes dash-style (color-text-secondary) and slash-style (color/action/primary-background) by when each variable was added -- same caveat as the global collection's naming note. color/ui/text/disabled and color/ui/text/primary are a separate, divergent pair from code's color-text-disabled/color-text-primary: 'disabled' is a pure rename with an identical value (safe to treat as the same token under a different name), but 'primary' also carries a different color value than what code currently ships (code pulled the value update but deliberately did NOT adopt the 'ui' name -- introducing a new 'ui' taxonomy category isn't registered in validate-color-taxonomy.js; see packages/tokens/README.md's Color scale section and the 2026-08-19 token-pull session notes). spacing/default, spacing/condensed, spacing/compressed, spacing/expanded, and spacing/double exist in Figma with no corresponding token in code at all -- flagged during the same session, not yet pulled in.
semantic._state_note: color-action-primary-background-hover was seen at VariableID:49:59 as of this refresh; a much earlier state (pre-2026-08-03) had also recorded it at :49:58, which was actually color/action/primary-background -- if a future diff shows both resolving to the same collection but different keys, trust a fresh dump-variable-map.js run over this cached file.

nodes._comment: Canvas nodes bound to semantic/component variables or component properties -- useful when a collection rebuild requires rebinding fills/strokes/fontFamily/etc, or when re-touching the button's icon slots.

buttonComponentSetProperties._comment: Component property keys on the wend-button COMPONENT_SET (10:13), added 2026-08-19 to support icon-left/icon-right per component/button.json. Bind icon instance nodes' componentPropertyReferences to these keys, not to a guessed/re-derived name -- the trailing #id changes if the property is ever deleted and recreated.
buttonComponentSetProperties.label: Label#10:1

nodes._variants_note: 10:13's other 11 variants (Hover/Active states, Tertiary, Destructive Primary/Secondary/Tertiary) aren't individually enumerated here, same as the pre-2026-08-19 state of this file -- discover by name (e.g. `set.children.find(c => c.name === 'Variant=Tertiary, State=Hover')`) rather than assuming an ID.
